title: Q3 2026 Financial Report
summary: Q3 2026 revenue rose 10.0% to AED 4,620,000 and net profit to AED 652,300; 14 active projects and an AED 38.4M contract backlog.

title: FY2026 Budget Summary
summary: AED 10,192,000 spent by 30 September (78.4% of the AED 13,000,000 budget); Sales & Marketing and IT & Digital are running over budget.

title: Employee Handbook 2025
summary: Policies on probation, working hours, salary payment (WPS, by the 25th), overtime, annual leave (22 days), sick leave, notice and remote work.

title: HR Policy Update 2026
summary: From 1 January 2026: 25 days of annual leave, up to 2 remote days per week for eligible roles, 5 days of parental leave and an AED 4,000 learning budget.

title: Procurement Policy 2026
summary: Approval limits by amount, three quotations above AED 25,000, no split purchases and 60-day supplier payment terms.

title: Executive Compensation 2026
summary: Confidential: 2026 packages for the CEO, CFO and COO (AED 255,000 per month in total) and their bonus targets.

title: Board Minutes Q3 2026
summary: Confidential: Abu Dhabi branch (AED 2.5M capital budget), Administration hiring freeze, 4% salary increase budget for 2027 and the Project Falcon study.
